title: Dulo Aims to Generate Valid Car and Plane Designs from AI Prompts
summary:
The AI startup is building software that converts natural language inputs into valid engineering designs for cars and planes. By automating the conceptualization of physical hardware, Dulo is positioning itself as a competitor to other artificial intelligence ventures funded by Larry Page and Jeff Bezos.

Launched earlier this year by former Google executive Sebastian Thrun and Adriana Oun, the company is focused on creating what it calls an "Engineering Superintelligence" to automate technical stages of product design. Dulo has raised $130 million in seed funding from investors including Eric Schmidt, John Doerr and DST Global.
